# 1h: deployment and cutover

## Read first

- [deployment.md](../deployment.md), [manual-checklist.md](../manual-checklist.md).
- `~/projects/sh-blackberry/CLAUDE.md`, `music.yaml`, `proxier.yaml`, `backup.yaml`, `.env`.
- `~/projects/sh-main/CLAUDE.md` section on adding a service, `nginx/conf.d/audiomuse.music.conf`, `compose.yaml`, `ssh-server/sshd_config.d/tunnel-restrict.conf`, `Makefile`.

## Done when

- Drafts are ready for the user to commit in sh-blackberry, sh-main and sh-secrets.
- The user has deployed them, and the rollout in deployment.md is done.
- Every check in manual-checklist.md passed, with its result recorded.
- shelf runs from its own `shelf.yaml`, and `music.yaml` is unchanged. The old pipeline's removal comes later, by the user.
- `docs/deployment.md` describes what runs, and `docs/status.md` closes phase 1.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Who commits | Claude drafts the changes in the infra repos; the user reviews, commits and deploys. | The user's rule for infra repos. |
| Layout | shelf, its own shelf-wrapper and its tunnel live in `shelf.yaml`, beside `music.yaml`. The old bot, `apple-music-api` and `apple-music-wrapper` keep running untouched. | The user's choice. The old pipeline goes later, in one change. |
| Wrapper | A second wrapper with its own data folder and `--device-info`, signed in from the Status page, instead of switching `apple-music-wrapper` to shelf-wrapper. | The old pipeline stays as it is. The staging run showed two wrappers on one Apple ID work side by side. |
| Telegram | A new bot for shelf. `music-download-bot` keeps its token. | The user's choice. Two processes can't poll one token. |
| Order | The rollout in deployment.md: shelf without Telegram, sign-in, import, web checks, then the new bot. | Each step is checked before the next. |
| Old data | `${SWINGMUSIC_DATA}/music-downloader-bot` stays until the user removes it. | It is the only copy of the old history. |
| Rollback | Stop `shelf.yaml`'s services. | The old pipeline never stopped. |

## Checklist

Every check in [manual-checklist.md](../manual-checklist.md), plus:

| Edge case | Check |
| --- | --- |
| `docker compose config -q` passes in sh-blackberry | run before handing over |
| The permission `find` on `qobuz/` and `apple-music/` lists nothing after the fix | run on blackberry |
| The tunnel on 10013 is healthy and the vhost asks for basic auth | `docker ps`, a browser |
| The old Apple Music path still works with shelf-wrapper signed in | one download through `music-download-bot` after the sign-in |

## As built

Finished on 2026-11-04. shelf, shelf-wrapper and `ssht-shelf` run on blackberry from `shelf.yaml`, and `music.yaml` is unchanged. The gateway serves `shelf.music.tikhonnnnn.com` on port 10013 behind basic auth. The user committed and deployed the drafts in sh-blackberry, sh-main and sh-secrets. shelf ran `114f699` for its first two downloads and has run `be76a2d` since 11:41 UTC.

The rollout in [deployment.md](../deployment.md) ran in its order. shelf-wrapper signed in with storefront RU, the import added all 169 rows of the old bot's database, and the new bot connected as `@music_shelf_bot`.

Results are in [manual-checklist.md](../manual-checklist.md). Claude ran checks 3 to 8, 10 and 11 through the API and over SSH, and the owner ran checks 1 and 2. Every check passed. The owner accepted check 9 without running each line, and check 12 because the backup task is the infrastructure that already ran. The UI ran on the owner's phone and tablet and in headless Chrome at 320, 390 and 820 pixels. The run found no bug.

Of the extra checks, the permission `find`, the tunnel and the vhost's 401 passed. The owner skipped the download through `music-download-bot` with shelf-wrapper signed in.

What differs from the contract:

- Backup: the swingmusic task copies all of shelf's folder, the live database too, by the owner's choice. See [decisions.md](../decisions.md).
- sh-blackberry `c0f3456` removed the `/import` mount from `shelf.yaml`. The running container still had it at the end of the step, and drops it at the next `docker compose up -d shelf`.

Notes for later:

- Removing `music-download-bot`, `apple-music-api` and `apple-music-wrapper` from `music.yaml` is the user's change. `${SWINGMUSIC_DATA}/music-downloader-bot` stays until then.
- The checks left Third, Portishead and Wish You Were Here 50 in the library.
- Qobuz's search said 24/192 for Wish You Were Here 50 and delivered 24/96. The folder name and `shelf.txt` follow what was delivered.
- Navidrome's own folder watcher scans new folders within seconds, before shelf's scan 30 seconds later.
